page.title: Brilliant or Blunder
page.lead: A move gives material. A brilliant sacrifice that wins, or a blunder the opponent punishes? The positions come from real puzzles, around your level. Answer fast: the run is timed and doesn't change your rating.
page.empty: No move to judge yet: the index hasn't been built.

player.question: Brilliant or blunder?
player.tip: This move gives material. Genius or blunder? Trust your first look.

explain.brilliant: The puzzle's combination: the material given comes back with interest.
explain.blunder: The move gives material for nothing: the line shows how the opponent punishes it.

feedback.brilliant: A real sacrifice: the combination wins.
feedback.blunder: A blunder: the line punishes it.
feedback.brilliantRight: You saw the genius behind the sacrifice. Look at the combination!
feedback.brilliantWrong: It wasn't a blunder: look at what the sacrifice brings.
feedback.blunderRight: Well spotted: this move doesn't hold. Look at the punishment.
feedback.blunderWrong: Beware of moves that look too good: this one gets punished.
